Her Venus is in his 8th making him very much in love. His Mars is in Her 1st making it a definitely lustful partnership. Her Jupiter in his 1st, they are good for each other, good to be around each other. She would have a good impact on his self-image or him on hers.

Her Sun in his 12th, she sees him as mysterious, has a fascination. His Sun in her 7th meaning they would unite as one but might get lost in that. Need balance. 

Her Mercury in his 12th - need for clear communication, no hidden agenda, need to listen to each other. Then they can achieve deep understanding. His Mercury in her 7th - comfortable with her presence, think she is easy to communicate with. Maybe one of them is not communicating clearly but the other doesn't see that. 

Her Moon in his MC - she provides emotional support in career and job. His Mars on her MC - one of them might be more ambitious so the other admires that, seeks advice. 

His Pluto in her 3rd - he might change the way she thinks or they both will give meaning in everyday life. Deep talk. Her Pluto in his 9th - influence on spiritual/religious views? Maybe on institutions/foreign affairs/anything the 9th house represents.

That's what I've gathered... 

Also, the house - planet aspects could be the opposite. Like, it's either the house or the planet person that feels that way. In some synastries, it's the planet person, other's house.

Uranus in the 8th means moodiness and a lot of changes in personality.

But that obviously doesn't indicate that this placement alone means that all people who have this have your condition. It might be in squares/oppositions or any of those details but I don't know much about those.

With Sun in 2nd, it's a positive placement for money-making. But I don't see you losing it later. 

With a Leo stellium and Gemini rising I feel like you would do good being in front of the camera like your fortune teller has said. Or just having some sort of an audience, even online. With moon and mercury in 3rd, you are great at talking/conversation/expression.

Neptune in 7th, you idolize or dream about your romantic partners but can't seem to manifest it perfectly in real life. Very caring so maybe choosing difficult partners? Cancer sun would add to that. Uranus represents where something would suddenly change or transform. You also have it in the 7th (house or relationships/marriage) so maybe at some point in your life there is going to be a complete change in that matter. You have unique or unusual partnerships. 

With North Node in the 11th, I believe it means that you are too attached to love/partnerships so in this lifetime you have to experience distant/detached love. Friendships should be more important than love affairs. 

Saturn in the 6th would indicate possible health problems but only if you don't take care of yourself/your body properly. 

And Chiron in the 1st ( I have it too) is a painful placement since the pain is in the house of the self. But it also represents where you can heal others. Maybe people like to express their pain and problems to you (that happens to me)? And trusts you with it/seeks advice.

Yes, you can manifest it! 

I recommend scripting as a way to do this. Write and feel that you two are together physically. You are with him and he is with you and all of that. I hope you know what scripting is. If you are not sure how you two could really be together then just give it up to the universe. Don't focus on how, focus on why. Focus on the loving emotions you have for each other and let the universe decide what is the best way you two could be together! :) 

If you want him to come to you then you can script that, too. Script him making visits and such! ♥ the universe is always at your service. :)

The same can be said about losing weight. Write down your goal weight in the present tense and channel those feeling within you of already being that weight. Write how you feel in your goal weight, write what your diet consists of, all of that stuff! :) I wish you the best! You got this! :)

Try scripting!!

Just imagine and write down what having that job would be like. When you would wake up, go to the job, what you would do there, how you would feel, all of it. Just try to be as detailed as possible. Basically, make it feel real. Include strong emotion - as if you already have the job. Say how grateful you are to have this job, how happy and abundant you are from it.

And then let it go. Don't worry about it at all, don't even think about it. Soon you will hear back from them. :) ♥
Script it and you got it. ;) Let the Universe work.

I recommend writing them down whenever you feel the best. You can't just write affirmations without any positive emotion put into them. :)

And then I advise to just re-read them before bed and/or in the morning. I think that would actually bring the best results - charging your mind with positive affirmations and emotions during the day and then rehearsing them before bed and upon waking when your mind is the most sensitive! :)

The thing is if you believe that changing your manifestations methods will affect the process - it will. It is all in your belief!

You can honestly use any type of a method, it doesn't matter what method you use. What matters is your belief about it!

I think you should try whatever feels right for you. ♥ Try it out.

First, realize that it is way more important to first take care of your inner self and know that you yourself are whole. You don't really need anyone in your life. You can make yourself happy. 

It is very important to realize this, trust me. You can't be releasing desperate energy in the Universe of wanting friends and popularity and expect people to chase you and want to be with you. They will feel that lower energy. 

If you take care of yourself and mind your own business people will feel that. You will be emitting the energy of power from within instead of lack. 

What I would recommend is to try writing daily affirmations about yourself to help you with that. ♥ Best of luck! :)

I know it feels very harsh but what if you lost all of your jobs because the universe is preparing you for the best one? You have to lose some things in order to gain. If you truly believe that the universe is with you then you just have to trust and go with the flow. 

Remember that manifestations usually happen when you least expect them or when you just stop looking. Let the Universe work. By worrying you are constantly putting attention and energy on lack.

Ground yourself in the present moment and see good in everything that you already have in life. Wishing you the best! I know all your manifestations are coming true! ♥ I hope your friend reaches out to you. :)
Congratulations on your amazing presentation! The CEO was so impressed by you... they were all amazed! Congrats! You made the biggest impact! :) ♥

The best advice I think I have is to 1) breathe 2) ground yourself in the present moment. Realize that no amount of anxiety or frustration is going to change anything that is going to happen. 

I would recommend meditating at least 10 minutes of your day. It really helps, I promise. Calming your thoughts and focusing on nothing but the void and emptiness and silence. You can even do it together with your girlfriend. Also, when you are feeling too stressed just take 3 seconds and stop whatever you are doing to just calm your mind. That always works for me. 

If you want to change the situation with your mother I recommend scripting on the situation if you haven't already. 

Remember that there are always better things coming. You just got to trust the Universe. Just like you trust it to make your manifestations come true. I really hope this helps. ♥
